note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a TAJ 15; A06b TAJ 15; L05 TAJ 23): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships (with major exceptions); a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another (with exceptions). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Tajikistan, 2024
sources.said: Person has had permanent and continuous residence for 5 years. ... Renunciation of other citizenship required (unless person is a Russian citizen (bilateral treaty)). ... Person voluntarily acquires citizenship of another country (unless there is a treaty on dual citizenship between the countries).
